name: onboarding_location
prompt:
Onboarding illustration for a location alert app, step 'location': it supports the message 'Pick the stop where you get off on the map'.
Show a small tilted rounded map tile with simple street lines, and a glowing mint location pin dropping onto one spot with a soft ring ripple on the map where it lands.
Style: clean flat vector illustration with a soft neon mint glow, rounded geometric shapes, minimal detail, consistent with the reference app icon (mint pin with an earbud on navy).
Palette limited to mint #6FE3D3, deep teal #0A7A6D, white, soft gray #98989F and dark navy #0B1622 shapes. The image must read on both a black and a light gray background, so give dark shapes a subtle mint rim light.
Composition: one subject group centered, square, generous empty margin, nothing touching the edges.
Transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI text, no device brand marks.
